name: The runnable 'spin up a new company's semantic system' SDK (genesis provisioner)
description: Andrew-direct 2026-07-18. Productize the process Opal used to build its compiled semantic system into a RUNNABLE provisioner: `genesis up <company>` stands up a new tenant's graph + ontology-binding + learning loop + tool suite on the proven stack (Nessie/Iceberg/Kuzu/Trino + AWS), parameterized. Opal is the reference instance; the SDK generalizes it. CORE IDEA = PACKAGE + PARAMETERIZE, not rebuild: the machinery already exists + is proven runnable (comp_recognizer_sdk / comp_ladder / cse_schema / the graph infra / the learning loop / the marker-oracle); generalization is narrow -- exactly TWO bespoke-per-company pieces (the recognizer keystone + the binding adapter), everything else becomes tenant-neutral via a company.yaml manifest. Home: infra/system/sdk/. Acceptance (this pass): local/sandbox proof -- genesis verify --local proves the loop CLOSES on a scratch Nessie namespace + local Kuzu (zero new cloud spend); genesis up --dry-run proves TF validate/plan clean. Plan of record: docs/architecture/NFRA_GENESIS_PRD.md (CTO arch-gate) + ~/.claude/plans.
phase: CORE ACCEPTANCE MET (Andrew-direct 2026-07-18, plan-approved). All under infra/system/sdk/ (ANY_EXEC_OR_AE); owner 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~A drives+owns. REMAINING (not in the local-proof acceptance): P1 TF remainder (derive/trino/producer families, additive); P4 the real cloud `up` apply (out of this pass -- Andrew scoped local/sandbox only); P5 the genesis comp-tool suite registration (ATOMIC-BUNDLE -> CTO, exec-locked) + verify --sandbox; P6 deferred (tree-sitter front-end, slot the CTO-gated NFRA_ONTOLOGY vocab, marker-CAS).
